1363	func applyEntry(s *loadedState, e *logEntry) error {
1364		corrupt := func(msg string, args ...any) error {
1365			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrCorrupt, fmt.Sprintf(msg, args...))
1366		}
1367		switch e.T {
1368		case kindSource:
1369			if e.Chain == "" {
1370				return corrupt("source entry with empty chain")
1371			}
1372			s.sources[e.Chain] = true
1373		case kindHeader:
1374			if e.Chain == "" || e.Height < 0 {
1375				return corrupt("bad header entry: %+v", e)
1376			}
1377			root, err := e.headerRoot()
1378			if err != nil {
1379				return corrupt("bad header entry: %v", err)
1380			}
1381			// Replay applies the shared header-state update rules with the
1382			// recovery acceptance policy: historical same-height coverage is never
1383			// rejected as a conflict, and recovery relies only on the header
1384			// records actually kept in the log. The latest header is the last one
1385			// written; the highest trusted header is the max-height trusted one,
1386			// with ties going to the later write (matching old overwrite
1387			// semantics). Neither is fabricated from lost history.
1388			hs := s.headers[e.Chain]
1389			if hs == nil {
1390				hs = &headerState{}
1391				s.headers[e.Chain] = hs
1392			}
1393			h := Header{Chain: e.Chain, Height: e.Height, Root: root, Trusted: e.Trusted}
1394			update, err := hs.planUpdate(h, replaySameHeight)
1395			if err != nil {
1396				return corrupt("bad header entry: %v", err)
1397			}
1398			hs.applyUpdate(h, update)
1399		case kindSubmit:
1400			if e.ID == "" || e.From == "" || e.To == "" || e.ProofAt < 0 || e.ExpiresAt < 0 {
1401				return corrupt("bad submit entry: %+v", e)
1402			}
1403			if _, dup := s.records[e.ID]; dup {
1404				return corrupt("duplicate submit for id %q", e.ID)
1405			}
1406			if e.Seq != s.nextSeq {
1407				return corrupt("submit seq %d out of order, expected %d", e.Seq, s.nextSeq)
1408			}
1409			payload, err := e.entryPayload()
1410			if err != nil {
1411				return corrupt("bad submit entry: %v", err)
1412			}
1413			s.records[e.ID] = &Record{
1414				Msg: Envelope{
1415					Message: Message{
1416						ID:      e.ID,
1417						From:    e.From,
1418						To:      e.To,
1419						Nonce:   e.Nonce,
1420						Payload: payload,
1421						ProofAt: e.ProofAt,
1422					},
1423					ExpiresAt: e.ExpiresAt,
1424				},
1425				Status: StatusPending,
1426				Reason: "awaiting first processing",
1427				Seq:    e.Seq,
1428			}
1429			s.nextSeq++
1430		case kindResult:
1431			// A plain result is one incremental processing outcome: it applies
1432			// only to a known, still non-terminal record, attempts must advance by
1433			// exactly one, and the processing time must be a non-negative instant
1434			// that never moves backwards — neither against the message's own prior
1435			// processing nor against any queue-wide time the log has already
1436			// confirmed: an advance checkpoint, or any earlier result or snapshot
1437			// of any message, checkpointed or not. A result stamped earlier than
1438			// that is an outcome no legal advance can have produced, however
1439			// intact and well-checksummed the record is. A waiting or success
1440			// result is a phase-1 due-processing outcome and must additionally be
1441			// stamped at a distinct instant at or after the retry the message's
1442			// previous result (or compacted state) scheduled: recovery may not
1443			// deliver — and consume a nonce for — a message whose backoff had not
1444			// elapsed, nor add a waiting attempt the live queue could not have
1445			// made. Replay and expired results are the phase-2 hold outcomes and
1446			// stay exempt: they settle a waiting message while its backoff is
1447			// still running, at the same instant as its wait included. A message's
1448			// first processing has no schedule to obey (time zero included). The
1449			// per-status validation (waiting schedule, success consumption,
1450			// terminal fields) is shared with compacted state entries.
1451			rec, ok := s.records[e.ID]
1452			if !ok {
1453				return corrupt("result for unknown id %q", e.ID)
1454			}
1455			if isTerminal(rec.Status) {
1456				return corrupt("result for terminal id %q", e.ID)
1457			}
1458			if err := validateRecoveryTime(e, recoveryResult); err != nil {
1459				return err
1460			}
1461			// s.now never drops below any record's LastProcAt, so the same-message
1462			// check is the queue-wide one restricted to this record; it stays
1463			// first to keep its historical error wording.
1464			if rec.Attempts > 0 && e.Now < rec.LastProcAt {
1465				return corrupt("result time %d before prior time %d for %q", e.Now, rec.LastProcAt, e.ID)
1466			}
1467			if e.Now < s.now {
1468				return corrupt("result time %d before known time %d for %q", e.Now, s.now, e.ID)
1469			}
1470			if e.Attempts != rec.Attempts+1 {
1471				return corrupt("attempts jump %d -> %d for %q", rec.Attempts, e.Attempts, e.ID)
1472			}
1473			if err := validateRecoveryStatus(e, recoveryResult); err != nil {
1474				return err
1475			}
1476			if err := validateRecoveryDue(rec, e); err != nil {
1477				return err
1478			}
1479			if err := acceptRecoveryStatus(s, rec, e, recoveryResult); err != nil {
1480				return err
1481			}
1482			applyRecoveredState(s, rec, e)
1483		case kindState:
1484			// A compacted snapshot stores the message's full current status after
1485			// >=1 attempts: it may restore an attempt count greater than one
1486			// directly, but it applies only to a known record and never twice for
1487			// the same message. Its processing time must be non-negative, but —
1488			// unlike a plain result — it need not exceed the times of the
1489			// snapshots before it: compaction writes snapshots in first-submission
1490			// order, each stamped with its own message's last processing instant,
1491			// so their times are not ordered among themselves. The per-status
1492			// validation is shared with plain result entries; the two kinds stay
1493			// distinct on disk.
1494			rec, ok := s.records[e.ID]
1495			if !ok {
1496				return corrupt("state for unknown id %q", e.ID)
1497			}
1498			if rec.Attempts != 0 {
1499				return corrupt("duplicate state for id %q", e.ID)
1500			}
1501			if err := validateRecoveryTime(e, recoveryState); err != nil {
1502				return err
1503			}
1504			if err := validateRecoveryStatus(e, recoveryState); err != nil {
1505				return err
1506			}
1507			if e.Attempts < 1 {
1508				return corrupt("state with zero attempts for %q", e.ID)
1509			}
1510			if err := acceptRecoveryStatus(s, rec, e, recoveryState); err != nil {
1511				return err
1512			}
1513			applyRecoveredState(s, rec, e)
1514		case kindAdvance:
1515			if e.Now < s.now {
1516				return corrupt("advance checkpoint %d before known time %d", e.Now, s.now)
1517			}
1518			s.now = e.Now
1519		default:
1520			return corrupt("unknown record type %q", e.T)
1521		}
1522		return nil
1523	}

1533	// validWaitingSchedule validates the retry instant recorded on a waiting
1534	// result or compacted-state entry against the processing time and attempt
1535	// number. The canonical schedule is nextRetryAt(now, attempts): now plus the
1536	// backoff delay, saturated at math.MaxInt64 when it would overflow.
1537	//
1538	// Logs written by older builds contain the raw now+delay even near the
1539	// ceiling, where the addition wrapped around to a value below now (typically
1540	// negative). That exact wrapped value is the only non-canonical schedule
1541	// accepted: it proves the entry came from the old scheduler rather than from
1542	// arbitrary corruption, and it is repaired in memory to the saturated
1543	// ceiling, which the next compaction persists. Any other retry time — zero,
1544	// an arbitrary instant, or a value before the processing time that is not the
1545	// exact legacy overflow — is rejected as corrupt.
1546	func validWaitingSchedule(now int64, attempts int, stored int64) (int64, bool) {
1547		canonical := nextRetryAt(now, attempts)
1548		if stored == canonical {
1549			return stored, true
1550		}
1551		wrapped := now + nextRetryDelay(attempts)
1552		if wrapped < now && stored == wrapped {
1553			return math.MaxInt64, true
1554		}
1555		return 0, false
1556	}

1706	// compact atomically replaces the log with a deterministic snapshot of live
1707	// state. It must run while Queue.mu is held (no concurrent mutation), and only
1708	// after in-memory state reflects every acknowledged append.
1709	func (s *store) compact(state *loadedState) error {
1710		entries := []*logEntry{{T: kindVersion, V: currentLogV}}
1711	
1712		chains := make([]string, 0, len(state.sources))
1713		for c := range state.sources {
1714			chains = append(chains, c)
1715		}
1716		sort.Strings(chains)
1717		for _, c := range chains {
1718			e := &logEntry{T: kindSource}
1719			e.setChain(c)
1720			entries = append(entries, e)
1721		}
1722	
1723		headerChains := make([]string, 0, len(state.headers))
1724		for c := range state.headers {
1725			headerChains = append(headerChains, c)
1726		}
1727		sort.Strings(headerChains)
1728		for _, c := range headerChains {
1729			hs := state.headers[c]
1730			// Write the highest trusted header first, then the latest header when
1731			// it differs. Replay reconstructs latest as the last entry and the
1732			// highest trusted as the max-height trusted entry, so this order
1733			// restores both exactly.
1734			if hs.trusted != nil {
1735				e := &logEntry{T: kindHeader, Height: hs.trusted.Height, Trusted: hs.trusted.Trusted}
1736				e.setChain(hs.trusted.Chain)
1737				e.setRoot(hs.trusted.Root)
1738				entries = append(entries, e)
1739			}
1740			if hs.trusted == nil || hs.latest != *hs.trusted {
1741				e := &logEntry{T: kindHeader, Height: hs.latest.Height, Trusted: hs.latest.Trusted}
1742				e.setChain(hs.latest.Chain)
1743				e.setRoot(hs.latest.Root)
1744				entries = append(entries, e)
1745			}
1746		}
1747	
1748		seqs := make([]int64, 0, len(state.records))
1749		bySeq := make(map[int64]*Record, len(state.records))
1750		for _, rec := range state.records {
1751			seqs = append(seqs, rec.Seq)
1752			bySeq[rec.Seq] = rec
1753		}
1754		sort.Slice(seqs, func(i, j int) bool { return seqs[i] < seqs[j] })
1755		for _, seq := range seqs {
1756			rec := bySeq[seq]
1757			// The submit entry is built by the same constructor the ordinary
1758			// appendSubmit path uses, so the snapshot restores the message's
1759			// original content and submission position byte for byte.
1760			entries = append(entries, newSubmitEntry(rec))
1761			if rec.Attempts > 0 {
1762				// The status entry is built by the same constructor the ordinary
1763				// appendOutcome path uses, only with kindState: the snapshot saves
1764				// the message's current status — not a new attempt — with the same
1765				// waiting schedule and success-consumption fill either path writes.
1766				nextRetry := int64(0)
1767				var consume *consumeToken
1768				if rec.Status == StatusWaiting {
1769					nextRetry = rec.NextRetry
1770				}
1771				if rec.Status == StatusSuccess {
1772					t := newConsumeToken(rec.Msg.Message.From, rec.Msg.Message.To, rec.Msg.Message.Nonce)
1773					consume = &t
1774				}
1775				re, err := newStatusEntry(kindState, rec.LastProcAt, nextRetry, rec.Attempts,
1776					rec.Msg.Message.ID, rec.Status, rec.Reason, consume)
1777				if err != nil {
1778					return err
1779				}
1780				entries = append(entries, re)
1781			}
1782		}
1783		if state.now > 0 {
1784			entries = append(entries, &logEntry{T: kindAdvance, Now: state.now})
1785		}
1786	
1787		tmp := filepath.Join(s.dir, logName+".compact")
1788		f, err := os.OpenFile(tmp, os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREATE|os.O_TRUNC, compactFileMode)
1789		if err != nil {
1790			return err
1791		}
1792		abort := func(err error) error {
1793			f.Close()
1794			os.Remove(tmp)
1795			return err
1796		}
1797		if _, err := f.WriteString(logMagic); err != nil {
1798			return abort(err)
1799		}
1800		for _, e := range entries {
1801			body, err := json.Marshal(e)
1802			if err != nil {
1803				return abort(err)
1804			}
1805			if _, err := f.Write(encodeFrame(body)); err != nil {
1806				return abort(err)
1807			}
1808		}
1809		if err := f.Sync(); err != nil {
1810			return abort(err)
1811		}
1812		if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
1813			os.Remove(tmp)
1814			return err
1815		}
1816		if err := os.Rename(tmp, filepath.Join(s.dir, logName)); err != nil {
1817			os.Remove(tmp)
1818			return err
1819		}
1820		if err := syncDir(s.dir); err != nil {
1821			return err
1822		}
1823		nf, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(s.dir, logName), os.O_RDWR|os.O_APPEND, compactFileMode)
1824		if err != nil {
1825			return err
1826		}
1827		if _, err := nf.Seek(0, io.SeekEnd); err != nil {
1828			nf.Close()
1829			return err
1830		}
1831		s.f.Close()
1832		s.f = nf
1833		if info, err := nf.Stat(); err == nil {
1834			s.size = info.Size()
1835		}
1836		return nil
1837	}

**`relayproof/store.go`**
- 新增 `validateSuccessRegistration`：对恢复出的 success（逐条 result 与压缩 state 共用同一入口）核对该消息自己的来源链是否已登记。由于 replay 按日志顺序应用记录，逐条结果天然只认可它之前的登记（提交后、成功前登记仍可放行；成功后才出现的登记不能补救）；压缩 state 则依据快照中保留的登记信息（压缩时登记写在记录之前），不重建已省略的历史。链名按原始字节精确匹配，`"a"` 的登记不能放行 `"a\x00b"`。
- 在 `acceptRecoveryStatus` 的 success 分支中，把登记核对放在可信覆盖核对之前——与正常推进 `processDue` 的判断顺序一致（先 unknown-source，再等待/投递）。
